name: Sprotopotamus
identity: Round stocky BLUE-VIOLET head with swept angular blue rear spikes, very large WHITE round eyes with glossy BLACK pupils and white glints, thick RED curved eyebrows and huge broad bright RED duck-like muzzle/lips. Small YELLOW side ear fins. RED outfit with thick narrow YELLOW round collar and yellow oval pendant in small dark rim at chest. Blue fingered hands, red trousers and yellow shoes. Preserve the enormous red muzzle and wide white eyes in every pose, rounded broad torso rather than thin body. Exclude pale blue background.
